'''Master Gunners''' were an elite group of highly experienced [[Starship/Legends|starship]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was a rare classification, with mainly family dynasties.

==Behind the scenes==
Master Gunner is a prestige class introduced in the [[2001]] [[roleplaying game]] supplement ''[[Starships of the Galaxy]]''.
